note: The primitive token starts at the input-controlled current JSON byte, so the token will reference bytes from the supplied buffer.
For an unterminated numeric top-level primitive, the token end is set to the input length rather than to a delimiter or NUL byte.
The parser converts the token start offset into a pointer into the original non-NUL-terminated fuzzer buffer.
The implementation knows the primitive's bounded length but does not copy or append a terminating NUL before using C numeric conversion routines.
strtol expects a NUL-terminated string and reads past the end of the unterminated numeric input while searching for the end of the number.
